feature: Own Your Growth assessment in the Alleato PM Training module

flows.name: Authenticated assessment and action plan
steps: Open My Growth from the authenticated Training module
Review the profile-suggested role and canonical skill library
Score every skill and supply recent evidence
Complete the top-four focus plan and 30/60/90-day cadence
flows.expectedOutcome: The exact canonical assessment and private action plan are persisted for the authenticated employee

flows.name: Reload persistence
steps: Observe the returned persisted check-in in history
flows.expectedOutcome: The saved check-in remains visible after reload and no transient success state is fabricated

flows.name: Privacy and tamper resistance
steps: Read the row as a different authenticated user
flows.expectedOutcome: Validation and database policy fail closed while the owner retains access

claims.description: The standalone assessment, Skill Wheel, focus plan, and cadence are integrated into the authenticated Training module
A check-in persists for the authenticated employee and remains visible after reload
Invalid, tampered, unauthenticated, and cross-user operations fail closed
